identity.function: existing tsfg.function and tsfg.signature domains with canonical concrete type names; method name qualified by its full owner identity
identity.type: existing tsfg.type NUL canonical concrete name; scalar names unchanged; Array<T>,ReadSpan<T>,Union<sorted concrete member names>,ref<runtimeKey>,value<runtimeKey>
identity.undefined: an initialized value of its concrete type; missing is never a value
identity.construction: sha256(tsfg.construction NUL owned owner TypeId); implicit parameter@constructionId:ordinal bindings retain original inheritedFrom and declaration origin

model.expressions: typed owned trees with separately retained declaredType and flow/result type, complete ranges and operator anchors; checked reads/stores/resize and explicit compound/update target
model.functions: complete source functions and constructors; original source binding and signature origins retained; methods have explicit implicit receiver binding
model.types: complete concrete catalogue with semantic TypeId and original logical type origin; fields,methods,constructor,base and official member compatibility mapped to owned identities
model.compatibilityWitnesses: Complete selected M12 member proof closure in owned TypeId/FieldId/FunctionId identities; explicit same-origin pair dependencies, cycles, every dependency consumed, every record root reachable; expression compatibilityRoots pair array refers to same actual expression origin; every root consumed by as and/or contextual ordinary relations
model.construction: Complete validated actual signatures, explicit function join or real logical implicit forwarding, owned parameter/member IDs and original origins. New expressions invoke owned construction; real superConstruct retains void result, direct-base construction and once-only arguments at original anchor, current receiver binding, and afterSuccess initializeOwnFields. Explicit base constructor body starts initializeOwnFields; implicit construction body forwards then initializes without inventing Source AST functions. Explicit functions carry construction-body role: bare constructorReturn has no fabricated owner expression; fallthrough uses the current instance. Construct signature/result and body completion are distinct; formal body lowering follows the existing M12 constructor result=none rule. Each construction declares a receiver binding with static viewType and preserve-actual-instance domain. Explicit super and logical forward carry that receiver binding; successful derived initialization uses the same binding. Base construction never reallocates or narrows the actual instance to the Base layout.
model.initialization: Ordered ordinary own field source definitions/initializers first, then parameter-property binding assignments under actual pinned ESNext semantics. Each initializer tree occurs only in construction.initialization, not duplicated in the field catalogue. initializeOwnFields consumes this ordered plan; uninitialized/native-empty definitions retain no invented Source expression. fieldDefine explicitly records native-undefined definition semantics without a fabricated Source literal or native typed-storage initialization qualification; legal later constructor field assignments remain in the body.

projection: Every field is reconstructed from a separately verified facts context and compared before print/read/lowering. Unknown and extra fields reject. Source objects never enter the backend.
status: development implementation; registry and formal Core/wire producer migration remains pending until the whole typed consumer is verified
